work.title: A clearer volunteer handoff
work.story: Volunteers were missing the next step at shift changes.
work.contribution: I interviewed two volunteers and wrote a one-page handoff guide.
work.tools: A shared document; feedback from the coordinator.
work.validation: Two volunteers tried the guide and identified one unclear instruction, which I revised.
work.outcome: The coordinator adopted the revised guide. I did not measure time savings.

direction.title: Customer support
direction.why: I like turning confusing processes into clear next steps.
direction.gap: I have not used a professional ticketing system.
direction.constraints: A predictable schedule matters to me.
direction.next_step: Compare this example with the required qualifications in three current support postings.
